messages:
maria: Quick idea — run a compact 2-hour joint tracing workshop + demo with Datadog and two SI partners in early May. Objective: show an end-to-end LLM trace (client request -> router -> model variant -> GPU pool) and a Datadog dashboard that ties request IDs to infra spans. High level ask: can we produce reproducible traces + one clear dashboard tile for the press? :spiral_calendar:

alex: Yes. Strong +1. Recommend we emphasize latency breakdowns (queueing, KV cache hit/miss, model tokens). We should standardize span names and tags ahead of time so dashboards are stable.

sam: I can build a lightweight synthetic trace generator that emits spans for: client, routing, batching, kv-cache, model-infer, and gpu-sched. It'll push to OTLP or directly to Datadog APM. Need an ephemeral OTLP endpoint and a sample config.

lee: Marketing here — sounds great. Two asks from my side: 1) embargo timeline + joint quote agreement, 2) assets: one-pager + 3 screenshots (dashboard + trace flamegraph + model perf table). I'll coordinate PR and press contacts.

maria: Embargo works. Proposed timeline: dry-run week of Apr 21, partner rehearsal Apr 28, public demo May 8. @lee you own PR/embargo. @sam can you have the demo script + trace generator by Apr 18?

sam: Yup. I'll also add a simple runbook for partners to replay locally. Example OTEL collector snippet I'm going to use (for quick sanity check):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  logging:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [logging]
```

alex: Nice. On the Datadog side we'll map service.name to: redwood-frontend, redwood-router, redwood-runtime, redwood-kv, redwood-gpu. Also set attributes: request.id, model.variant, batch.size, cache.hit (bool). Datadog query stub for a tile: `avg:trace.duration{service:redwood-runtime,model.variant:ggml*} by {model.variant}`

sam: I'll generate a sample payload that includes the tags above. Putting a lightweight demo repo here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/trace-workshop-demo (will be public internal link once ready).

maria: For partners: we should prepare a short deck slide with: architecture diagram, span taxonomy, dashboard screenshots, and a reproducible command to run the generator. Lee: can you draft the deck outline? Alex: can you confirm Datadog widget types we'll use (flamegraph + trace search + time series)?

lee: I'll own deck outline + speaker notes. Suggest we also prep an FAQ about data retention and PII (partners always ask).

alex: Confirming widget set. Also recommend we enable trace sampling=100% for demo cluster and add a note to scale down when partners test on their infra.

eng-deploy-bot: Reminder: ephemeral demo cluster provision request created (ticket #INC-4821). Will post kubeconfig to the partners channel once ready.

maria: Nice, thanks. Action items recap:
- sam: trace generator + runbook (due Apr 18)
- lee: deck + embargo/PR plan (due Apr 15)
- alex: Datadog widget configs + span/tag checklist (due Apr 10)
- maria: coordinate partner invites + rehearsal schedule (sending invites this afternoon)

sam: I'll start a branch and ping you when the generator can push to OTLP.

lee: I'll start a press contact draft and share for review.

maria: Awesome. Adding a short rehearsal agenda: 10m intro, 35m live demo, 25m dashboard walkthrough, 20m partner Q&A. If nobody objects I'll lock dates and loop in partners (cc Jordan at Datadog) later today. :thumbsup:

alex: Cool. No objections from me.

maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up with invites and a meeting doc.

eng-deploy-bot: Ticket #INC-4821 updated: kubeconfig uploaded to secure bucket (link posted in partners channel).

maria: Closing loop — will post rehearsal invite and attach the checklist.
